Megakem Tile Grout – Polymer Modified Cementitious Joint Filler
Megakem Tile Grout is a high-performance, polymer-modified cementitious joint filler engineered for sealing and finishing tile joints in residential, commercial, and industrial developments. It mixes smoothly into a workable paste, provides a dense and uniform joint, and forms a durable, water-resistant, and crack-free barrier once cured. The advanced formulation incorporates high-strength binding polymers, water-repellent chemicals, and shrinkage-compensated additives to deliver superior adhesion and long-lasting protection against moisture ingress.
Ideal for ceramic, porcelain, mosaic, and natural stone tiles, Megakem Tile Grout creates a seamless, aesthetic finish while preventing dirt accumulation and fungal growth in high-humidity spaces. It is easy to apply, cleans off tile edges effortlessly, and offers exceptional bond strength, allowing applicators to achieve flawless, professional joint lines in both dry and architectural wet areas with minimal effort.

name: MegaFlex 100
description:
Product Description: MegaFlex 100

MegaFlex 100 – Premium Acrylic Elastomeric Crack Sealant

Restore the integrity of your surfaces with MegaFlex 100, a high-performance, single-component crack sealant engineered with advanced British technology. Designed for both interior and exterior use, this water-based, acrylic elastomeric formula provides a permanent, ultra-flexible solution for sealing plaster, skim coat, and drywall cracks.

Unlike rigid fillers, MegaFlex 100 dries into a seamless membrane with over 450% elongation, allowing it to move with your building’s natural expansion and contraction. Its non-sag, ready-to-use formulation makes it easy to apply on both vertical and horizontal surfaces, ensuring a smooth, paintable finish that stands up to demanding environmental conditions.

Key Benefits & Features:

  • Superior Crack-Bridging: Ultra-flexible formula capable of bridging cracks up to 2 mm.

  • High Elasticity: Exceptional $\ge450\%$ elongation at break ensures long-lasting performance.

  • Versatile Application: Ideal for interior and exterior absorbent surfaces, including drywall, gypsum boards, and masonry.

  • Weather & UV Resistant: Specially formulated to maintain integrity under extreme climatic variations.

  • Professional Finish: Smooth, non-sag consistency that is paintable once fully cured.

  • Ready-to-Use: No mixing required; apply directly with a scraper, putty trowel, or brush.

  • Safe & Durable: Lead-free, non-toxic, and non-flammable.

Expert Support:

Need guidance on surface preparation or multi-layer application? We provide free consultations on cleaning, priming techniques, and applying MegaFlex 100 for a flawless, watertight finish.

Choose MegaFlex 100 for a professional, durable, and weather-resistant seal.

Build seamless. Build lasting.

name: Megakem RFS
description:
MEGAKEM RFS (Roof Fastener Sealant) – Water-Based Acrylic Elastomeric Waterproofing Sealant

MEGAKEM RFS (Roof Fastener Sealant) is a single-component, ready-to-use, water-based acrylic elastomeric waterproofing sealant engineered for sealing and protecting critical roofing interfaces. Upon curing, it forms a seamless, ultra-flexible waterproof membrane that delivers outstanding adhesion and complete weather resistance across both horizontal and vertical surfaces without slippage or deformation.

Formulated with a specialized blend of styrene acrylic co-polymer emulsion, weather-resistant pigments, fillers, and non-corrosive materials, MEGAKEM RFS is specifically designed to handle extreme climatic variations. It exhibits superior elongation of ≥ 450%, allowing it to expand and contract with structural movement while eliminating leak paths around roof fasteners, solar panel mounting points, bolt heads, washer interfaces, and roof sheet joints.

Manufactured in Sri Lanka using advanced British technology, this lead-free and non-toxic compound ensures consistent quality and long-term durability under demanding environmental conditions. It applies smoothly directly from the container using a brush, putty trowel, or scraper without dilution, and offers effortless water clean-up for tools immediately after application.

  • ✅ Forms an ultra-flexible, seamless waterproof seal with ≥ 450% elongation

  • ✅ Advanced non-sag formulation suitable for both horizontal and vertical applications without dripping or slippage

  • ✅ Ideally suited for roof fasteners, solar panel mounting brackets, bolt heads, washer interfaces, and sheet joints

  • ✅ Excellent UV and weather resistance engineered to withstand extreme climatic variations

  • ✅ Fast-drying, single-component, and ready-to-use directly from the container

  • ✅ Can be diluted with 30% clean water to act as a self-sealing primer coat on porous or chalky substrates

  • ✅ Lead-free, non-toxic, and non-flammable water-based compound with easy water clean-up for tools

  • ✅ Available in convenient 1 kg containers

Need help applying it correctly? We provide free consultations on surface preparation, anti-corrosive priming for rusted metal hardware, dilution ratios for chalky substrates, and proper joint coverage rates to ensure a durable, watertight seal.
